cues.en: Machine learning and data science are already the hottest fields in the world, and it's time to turn it up a notch.
cues.zh: 機器學習與資料科學已經是全球最熱門的領域，現在是時候再提升一個層次。

cues.en: Welcome to the hottest place to learn PyTorch and become a master of deep learning.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到學習 PyTorch、成為深度學習高手最熱門的地方。

cues.en: If you don't already know what PyTorch is, here's the deal.
cues.zh: 如果你還不知道 PyTorch 是什麼，簡單說明一下。

cues.en: PyTorch is a machine learning framework written in Python code.
cues.zh: PyTorch 是一個以 Python 程式碼撰寫的機器學習框架。

cues.en: It enables you to craft state of the art deep learning algorithms like neural networks powering much of today's artificial intelligence applications.
cues.zh: 它讓你打造最先進的深度學習演算法，例如驅動當今許多人工智慧應用的神經網路。

cues.en: Sounds hot, right?
cues.zh: 聽起來很火熱，對吧？

cues.en: That's because PyTorch is on fire right now.
cues.zh: 因為 PyTorch 現在真的很火，

cues.en: And I don't just mean the name or the logo.
cues.zh: 我說的不只是它的名稱或標誌。

cues.en: It's used by leading tech companies like Tesla to build the computer vision systems for their self-driving cars.
cues.zh: Tesla 等領先科技公司，用它打造自駕車的電腦視覺系統；

cues.en: Meta to power the curation and understanding systems for their content timelines.
cues.zh: Meta 用它支援內容動態消息的篩選與理解系統；

cues.en: Apple to create computationally enhanced photography and even automated weed killing tractors.
cues.zh: Apple 用它製作經運算增強的攝影功能，甚至還有自動除草的曳引機。

cues.en: Plus, much of the latest machine learning research is done and published using PyTorch code.
cues.zh: 此外，許多最新的機器學習研究，都使用 PyTorch 程式碼進行與發表。

cues.en: So knowing how to write and read PyTorch code means you'll be at the cutting edge of the field.
cues.zh: 所以學會撰寫、閱讀 PyTorch 程式碼，就能站在這個領域的前沿。

cues.en: You know, the best way to learn is by doing right.
cues.zh: 你知道，最好的學習方式就是動手做，對吧？

cues.en: Well, consider this course a PyTorch momentum builder side by side, line by line will be writing PyTorch
cues.zh: 把這門課當成建立 PyTorch 學習動力的過程。我們會一起，一步一步、一行一行地撰寫 PyTorch

cues.en: code together, apprenticeship style, helping you learn the PyTorch skills you'll use every day as a data scientist or a machine learning engineer.
cues.zh: 程式碼，採用學徒式學習，幫助你學會資料科學家或機器學習工程師每天會用到的 PyTorch 技能。

cues.en: We'll start with the bare bones fundamentals.
cues.zh: 我們從最基本的基礎開始，

cues.en: So even if you're new to machine learning, you'll be caught up to speed.
cues.zh: 即使你剛接觸機器學習，也能跟上進度。

cues.en: Then we'll explore more advanced areas, including PyTorch, workflows, PyTorch, neural network classification,
cues.zh: 接著探索更進階的領域，包括 PyTorch 工作流程、PyTorch 神經網路分類、

cues.en: computer vision, custom data sets, experiment, tracking model, deployment, and my personal favorite
cues.zh: 電腦視覺、自訂資料集、實驗追蹤、模型部署，以及我個人最喜歡的

cues.en: transfer learning a powerful technique for taking what one machine learning model has learned on another problem and applying it to your own.
cues.zh: 遷移學習：把某個機器學習模型在其他問題上學到的知識，應用到你自己問題上的強大技巧。

cues.en: Along the way, you'll build three milestone projects surrounding an overarching project called Food Vision, a neural network computer vision model to classify images of food.
cues.zh: 過程中，你會圍繞一個叫做 Food Vision 的整體專案，建立三個里程碑專案。Food Vision 是用來分類食物影像的神經網路電腦視覺模型。

cues.en: These milestone projects will help you practice using PyTorch whilst covering important machine learning
cues.zh: 這些里程碑專案會讓你練習使用 PyTorch，同時涵蓋重要的機器學習

cues.en: concepts and create a portfolio you can show to employers and say, Here's what I've done by the end of this course.
cues.zh: 概念，建立可以展示給雇主的作品集，說：「這就是我做過的成果。」這門課結束時，

cues.en: You'll have a vast amount of hands on experience with PyTorch and will be comfortable interacting with public PyTorch projects, building your own PyTorch projects and accelerating your career in the wonderful
cues.zh: 你會累積大量 PyTorch 實作經驗，能自在參與公開的 PyTorch 專案、建立自己的專案，並加速你在精彩的

cues.en: world of machine learning.
cues.zh: 機器學習世界中的職涯發展。

cues.en: And silly me, I almost forgot to introduce myself.
cues.zh: 我真糊塗，差點忘了自我介紹。

cues.en: I'm Daniel Berg, your PyTorch instructor.
cues.zh: 我是 Daniel Bourke，你的 PyTorch 講師。

cues.en: I'm a self-taught machine learning engineer with experience at one of Australia's fastest growing artificial intelligence companies.
cues.zh: 我是自學的機器學習工程師，曾在澳洲成長最快的人工智慧公司之一工作。

cues.en: And now I teach the latest in-demand machine learning skills to thousands of students across the globe.
cues.zh: 現在我向全球數千名學生，教授最新、熱門的機器學習技能。

cues.en: In this course, we're going to learn to master PyTorch together.
cues.zh: 這門課裡，我們會一起學會精通 PyTorch。

cues.en: I want you to be able to think and work through machine learning problems like a machine learning engineer does.
cues.zh: 我希望你能像機器學習工程師一樣思考，並逐步解決機器學習問題。

cues.en: So when it comes time to apply your new skills as a machine learning engineer.
cues.zh: 所以當你成為機器學習工程師，要運用新技能時，

cues.en: You've already had plenty of practice because that's the goal, right?
cues.zh: 已經有充分練習了，因為這就是目標，對吧？

cues.en: If you want to learn the skills required for a career in machine learning, if you want to learn the most popular machine learning framework used by companies like Tesla and Apple, if you like to learn
cues.zh: 如果想學會機器學習職涯所需的技能，如果想學會 Tesla 與 Apple 等公司使用的熱門機器學習框架，如果喜歡

cues.en: by doing.
cues.zh: 透過動手做來學習，

cues.en: If you'd like to master PyTorch, you've come to the right place.
cues.zh: 如果想精通 PyTorch，那你就來對地方了。

cues.en: I'll see you inside.
cues.zh: 課程裡見。

cues.en: Let's code.
cues.zh: 開始寫程式吧。
